name: 2WikiMultiHopQA
description: 2WikiMultiHopQA is a multi-hop question answering dataset constructed over two Wikipedia documents. It contains five types of multi-hop reasoning: inference, comparison, bridge-comparison, compositional, and bridge questions. Evidence is collected from both Wikipedia and Wikidata, enabling evaluation of multi-hop reasoning with explicit evidence chains.
typical_sota_score: ~50-60 F1 (comparison type is hardest; human ~90 F1)
reputation: Large multi-hop QA benchmark with diverse reasoning types; published at COLING 2020; widely used alongside HotpotQA for multi-hop QA evaluation
notes: Introduced at COLING 2020. Contains 192,606 questions (167,454 train, 12,576 dev, 12,576 test). Five reasoning types: inference, comparison, bridge-comparison, compositional, and bridge. Questions about both entities in two Wikipedia articles using Wikidata relations. Used alongside HotpotQA and MuSiQue for multi-hop QA evaluation benchmarking.
